description: This file provides utility functions for safe numeric operations, including overflow detection for addition and multiplication of integral types, and safe multiplication over iterators and containers.

methods.name: add_overflows
methods.description: Detects overflow in addition for integral types, using compiler built-ins if available, otherwise manual checks for signed and unsigned types.

methods.name: mul_overflows
methods.description: Detects overflow in multiplication for integral types, using compiler built-ins if available, otherwise manual checks for signed and unsigned types.

methods.name: safe_multiplies_u64
methods.description: Performs safe multiplication over a range of values or a container, detecting overflow.
